stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: Draw the rota so nobody doubts it.
stations.note: And four numbers by the weekend.

stations.title: Duty rota
stations.text: Names from a hat, and nobody can check it.

captions: At the base, Rhona asks for a fair duty rota and four answers before the training weekend.
Today names come out of a hat, and a draw nobody can repeat is a draw people doubt.
You round, take a square root, sum up the hours, and draw with a seed you can use again.
Now the rota has every volunteer once, and the same seed draws it again in front of them.
Rhona has her numbers, and the team trusts a rota they watched drawn twice.
